Name: Cosmetic Rings
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/ecl5gzA.png[/img]﻿[b][size=4]
Many rings. Many effects.[/size][/b][b][size=4][/size][/b][/center][b][size=4]

[/size][/b]
﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/rkHX3OF.png[/img]﻿[size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Adds various cosmetic rings to the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Abandoned_House]Hat Mouse's shop[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]Ring effects vary from summoning a follower (butterfly, rabbit, fairy and Junimos) to purely visual (rain cloud, petals).[/size]
[*][size=3]Many rings have idle effects, which occur when the player stands still.[/size]
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XU0dXfs.png[/img]﻿

[size=3][b][size=4]Bunny Ring
[/size][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Spawns a bunny to follow you around.[/size]
[*][size=3]Occasionally jumps![/size]
[*][size=3]25% chance of summoning a baby rabbit instead.[/size]
[/list]

[size=3][b][size=4]Butterfly Ring
[/size][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=3]Spawns a random butterfly to follow you around.[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]If you stand still, the butterfly may randomly land on your head.[/size][/size]
[/list]

[size=3][b][size=4]Fairy Ring
[/size][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=3]Spawns a fairy to follow you around.[/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=3]Gives off light at night / in the dark.[/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=3]If you stand still, the fairy will wander around.[/size][/size][/size]
[size=3]
[/size][/list][size=3][b][size=4]Junimo Ring
[/size][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=3]Spawns a randomly colored Junimo to follow you around.[/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=3]Occasionally jumps and meeps![/size][/size][/size]
[size=3]
[/size][/list][size=3][b][size=4]Petal Ring
[/size][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=4][size=3]Spawns falling cherry blossoms around you.[/size][/size][/size]
[size=3][size=4][size=3]
[/size][/size][/size][/list][size=3][b][size=4]Raindrop Ring
[/size][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=4][size=3]Spawns a rain cloud that follows you around.[/size][/size][/size][/size]
[/list][size=3][size=4][size=3]

[/size][/size][/size][size=3][b][size=4]Slime Ring
[/size][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=4][size=3]Spawns a randomly colored slime to follow you around.[/size][/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=4][size=3]Rare chance of it being spawned as a prismatic slime.[/size][/size][/size][/size]
[/list]

[size=3][b][size=4]Dust Ring
[/size][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=4][size=3]Spawns a dust sprite that bounces around.[/size][/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=4][size=3]Occasionally meeps.[/size][/size][/size][/size]
[/list]

[size=3][b][size=4]Firefly Ring
[/size][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=4][size=3]Spawns a small cluster of fireflies around you.[/size][/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=4][size=3]Give off a more steady light compared to fairy.[/size][/size][/size][/size]
[/list]

[size=3][b][size=4]Frog Ring
[/size][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=4][size=3]Spawns a frog to follow you around.[/size][/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=4][size=3]Frog currently has two random variations for color.[/size][/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=4][size=3]Occasionally croaks.[/size][/size][/size][/size]
[/list]

[size=3][b][size=4]Bat Ring
[/size][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=4][size=3]Spawns a random bat of different [size=3][size=3][size=4][size=3]variations[/size][/size][/size][/size] to follow you around.[/size][/size][/size][/size]
[/list][size=3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mTvZy59.png[/img]
Currently not supported, though it will be in the future. Technically it should work in multiplayer, but the ring effects may not appear to the other players.
[/size][size=3]
[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3xXM468.png[/img][size=3]﻿﻿﻿
I have not encountered any mods that are incompatible, but always make sure your saves are backed up.

[b]This mod is compatible with Wear More Rings.[/b]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZHvv8Nw.png[/img][size=4]
[b]How do I...[/b][/size][size=3]

Get a ring?
[/size][list]
[*]After you've unlocked the Hat Mouse's shop, you'll be able to purchase them.
[/list]
[size=3][size=3]Use multiple of the same ring?
[/size][list]
[*]Most rings that summon things will work when wearing multiples of the ring, however it isn't officially supported.
[*]This means if you have problems while wearing two of the same ring, but not when wearing just one, then it isn't a priority issue for me to fix.
[/list]
[/size][size=3][size=3]Get rid of my summoned Junimo, etc. ?
[/size][list]
[*]Unequipping the ring should despawn any summoned familiar.
[/list]
[size=3][size=3]Change the color of the butterfly / Junimo?
[/size][list]
[*]Unequipping and reequipping the ring will cause a new color to be randomly picked.
[/list]
[size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3]Give a suggestion for a new ring?
[/size][list]
[*]Post a comment with your idea and I'll let you know if it is feasible!
[/list][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]
